gen-gf-grandstander-fs-rowan: Grandstander lays down bold, plain-width lines with tall lowercase and short ascenders, a loud and friendly voice up top, while Rowan answers in a text serif. Grandstander earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-almendra: Grandstander draws every line like a fineliner, flat and bold. Almendra sits beneath with a deep, low midsection and a bookish serif dignity, so the loud top and the settled body hold different ground.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-bree-serif: Hairline-free, shadow-free strokes give Grandstander its blunt, expressive face. Big and short is where it pays off, with Bree Serif underneath, its classic serif lowercase wide and low.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-port-lligat-slab: Chunky, cheerful, and uninterrupted in line width. Grandstander shouts in tall lowercase, and Port Lligat Slab lets its porthole counters and roomy curves bring the traditional, literary calm of a classic serif.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-quando: Quando reads slow and bookish, its wide spacing and tall middle zone giving a text serif plenty of room. Its strongest quality is the gap from Grandstander, whose flat, unmodulated bold lines feel loud beside it.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-rowan: Rowan brings a friendly, literary voice with generous curve openings and thin strokes about half as heavy as the thick ones, a classic serif with warmth. Gugi, in contrast, keeps its width through every turn.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-almendra: Gugi is all tall lowercase and open terminals, a bold single-width stroke. And Almendra, a text serif with a deep, low midsection, would read as dignified and bookish over a longer stretch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads refined and literary, its serif lowercase oversized and low. Gugi, meanwhile, supplies a gentle, monotone line, tall lowercase and open-cut terminals above it, a lively contrast with that wide body.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-port-lligat-slab: Port Lligat Slab is a literary text serif with wide, porthole-like counters, hugging shapes and open-ended curves, set against Gugi's single constant line. A bigger size for Gugi suits it best.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-quando: Gugi looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, tall lowercase nearly touching its capitals. Quando, a serif with sparse spacing and a big middle zone, follows quietly, letting the bold heading speak first.
